task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Hold the lightweight handheld barcode scanner in one arm and the tea box with leafy design in the other, then scan the tea box with leafy design with the lightweight handheld barcode scanner.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架，一臂托住轻量手持式条码扫描器，另一臂托住绿叶图案茶叶盒，然后用轻量手持式条码扫描器扫描绿叶图案茶叶盒。
